item.title: Trump picks veteran staffer to head Bureau of Labor Statistics
item.description: President Trump plans to nominate economist Brett Matsumoto to head the Bureau of Labor Statistics, elevating a career staffer who has worked at the agency since 2015.

item.description: Obamacare enrollment projected to drop by over 1 million Americans as health insurance premiums surge following the end of COVID-era federal subsidies in 2026.

item.description: Paul Allen's estate will reportedly sell the Seattle Seahawks after the Super Bowl, marking a major shift in the NFL franchise’s future ownership.

item.title: Josh Altman sounds alarm on California wealth tax, says workers would pay the price
item.description: "Million Dollar Listing" star Josh Altman sounds alarm on California's 5% billionaire tax, warning of devastating "trickle-down" impact on economy.

item.title: Johnny Carson's former Bel Air mansion hits the market for staggering $40M price tag after decades
item.description: Johnny Carson's former Bel Air mansion hits the market for $40 million. The 9,052-square-foot luxury home features six bedrooms, a tennis court and a pool.

item.title: Travelers without a REAL ID are about to be hit with a TSA fee
item.description: TSA launched a new ConfirmID system for travelers without REAL ID or an acceptable form of ID, but it costs $45 and may cause delays at airport security.

item.title: Toyota recalls 161K Tundra trucks over rearview camera defect that increases crash risk
item.description: Toyota recalls over 161,000 Tundra trucks due to software defect possibly preventing rearview camera display, increasing crash risk, according to federal regulators.
